items.title: RFP Library 5-year Strategic Plan
items.description:
RFP- Douglas County Public Library, A New Five-Year Strategic Plan 2028 to 2033

Posted- 11/2/2026

Bids due- 11/20/2026

Looking for a company or organization to help with the planning process of a new library strategic plan for the Douglas County Public Library.

Description: Planning process

Early 2027- help with the development process of a new strategic plan including the following starting in January 2027

1. Internal and External Stakeholder- small group interviews

2. Community survey- digital and paper. Use of the 2022 Survey as a “Base Comparison” with new questions as needed. Data input of surveys and summary analysis of the information.

3. Collection and analysis of various socio-demographic, economic, and housing characteristics,

4. Up to three strategic planning workshops (if needed) conduction of workshops with summary and analysis

a. Workshop 1- community and organizational assessment with the development of draft key elements (core values, mission/vision, goals, etc.)

b. Workshop 2 & Workshop 3 (if needed) Refinement and development of the final key elements

5. Development/Completion of a technical report

6. Create a 2028 plan for implementation

Four separate annual evaluations and updates:

2029, 2030, 2031, 2032

Development/completion of four technical reports (summaries)

Proposal based on services provided

Contact information

Timothy DeGhelder- Library Director

Questions and proposals can be emailed to the following address (e-mail address on the county page)

The current strategic plan can be viewed at the current webpage: https://shorturl.at/60Fiz

Review and Download the Full RFP Here
